# Tabs

A tab strip with its panels. Tabs go into the tablist and every other child, usually Panels, renders after it.

Also asked as: switch views, tab bar, segmented, view switcher.

**Import:** `import { Tabs } from '@/components';`

**Used in:** Page (`ds guide page`); Modal (`ds guide modal`); Section (`ds guide section`); Popup (`ds guide popup`)

**Governed by:** Filtering (`ds guide filtering`); Indicators (`ds guide indicators`); Navigation (`ds guide navigation`); Notifications (`ds guide notifications`)

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/Tabs/Tabs.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/Tabs/Tabs.stories.jsx` — Overview, Layout, Alignment, Appearance, UnderlineRadius, WithPanels, InteractionStates, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Selected, SelectedPill, Disabled

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/Tabs/Tabs.mdx`

**Motion:** change `spatial.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `Tabs` for the tab bar that switches between sibling views on the same page
— a student's Overview / Sessions / Progress, or the sections of an admin page.
Compose it from `Tabs.Tab` children, and declare a `Tabs.Panel` alongside each
one when the tab's content should be owned by the component rather than rendered
separately.

It can be uncontrolled (`defaultActiveKey`) or controlled (`activeKey` plus
`onSelect`). `alignment` covers left, center, right and `justified`, which
stretches the tabs to fill the bar. `appearance` is `default` (an underline) or
`pill` (a filled, rounded selected tab); `spacing` is `default` (`--control-md`) or
`compact` (`--control-sm`).

## Motion

Tabs reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Switch views | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | The indicator glides; both tab bodies slide together toward the chosen tab, no fade. Pill views: the fill glides and the content swaps in place. |

## Alternatives

- For navigating to a different page in a hierarchy, use `Breadcrumb` or `Sidebar`.
- For more options than fit on one strip without wrapping, use `Select`.
- For a second-level choice inside a view, use `PopupSelect`.
- For filtering a list rather than switching between views, use `FilterMenu` or `RadioGroup`.

## Best practices

### Pass `onSelect` whenever `activeKey` is controlled. {#pass-onselect-whenever-activekey-is-controlled}

```jsx
// Incorrect — activeKey pins the bar and nothing updates it.
<Tabs activeKey="overview">
  <Tabs.Tab eventKey="overview">Overview</Tabs.Tab>
  <Tabs.Tab eventKey="sessions">Sessions</Tabs.Tab>
</Tabs>

// Correct.
<Tabs activeKey={tab} onSelect={setTab}>
  <Tabs.Tab eventKey="overview">Overview</Tabs.Tab>
  <Tabs.Tab eventKey="sessions">Sessions</Tabs.Tab>
</Tabs>
```

### Give every `Tabs.Tab` an `eventKey`. {#give-every-tabs-tab-an-eventkey}

```jsx
// Incorrect — with no eventKey, there is no key to compare against activeKey,
// so the tab never shows as selected and onSelect fires with nothing useful.
<Tabs activeKey={tab} onSelect={setTab}>
  <Tabs.Tab>Overview</Tabs.Tab>
</Tabs>

// Correct.
<Tabs activeKey={tab} onSelect={setTab}>
  <Tabs.Tab eventKey="overview">Overview</Tabs.Tab>
</Tabs>
```

### Keep the labels short and parallel. {#keep-the-labels-short-and-parallel}

Each label is one or two words naming a view of the same subject: Overview, Sessions, Progress. Parallel wording lets people scan the strip without reading it.

Do: Short nouns for views of the same subject.
Don't: Mixed verbs and phrases that do not scan.

### Choose the appearance by weight, not taste. {#choose-the-appearance-by-weight-not-taste}

The underline suits a strip that sits above page content. The pill suits a strip inside a card or toolbar, where a filled selected tab reads as a control.

Do: A pill strip inside a card reads as a control.
Don't: The page-level underline inside a card, where it reads as a stray rule.

### Keep labels the same across visits. {#keep-labels-the-same-across-visits}

A label names a view. A count or status in it changes the name and breaks the parallel wording.

Do: The label names the view.
Don't: Counts and status in the label.

### Keep one tab system per page and use `PopupSelect` for a second-level choice. {#keep-one-tab-system-per-page-and-use-popupselect-for-a-second-level-choice}

A `pill` strip is a fixed set of views of one subject, decided when the page is designed, so it has no add-view control and people cannot create, rename, reorder or remove a tab. A strip that must grow with the data is a list or a `Select`, not tabs. A page has one tab system: the underline strip under the page header switches the page's sections, and a pill strip inside a card switches that card's views, without stacking two strips of the same kind. For a second-level choice inside a view, use the labeled trigger of `PopupSelect` ("Status: Upcoming") in the view's toolbar.

Do: One strip for the sections; a labeled PopupSelect for the choice inside one.
Don't: A second strip under the first, so two tab systems compete.

### Swap content in place without sliding. {#swap-content-in-place-without-sliding}

Switching tabs is a frequent action. The selected marker transitions quickly, and the content under the strip swaps in place with no slide or fade-through. Reduced motion removes the transition and the marker changes at once.

## Accessibility

- **A real tab widget, always.** `role="tablist"` on the strip, `role="tab"`
  and `aria-selected` on each tab, `aria-controls` pointing at the panel when
  one is declared, and roving tabindex: one stop for the whole strip, with
  Left, Right, Home and End moving selection and focus together. Tabs are real
  `<button>` elements, so activating one pushes no history entry and moves no
  scroll position.
- **A disabled tab stays reachable by the arrow keys**, so its existence is
  discoverable, but is never selected — `isDisabled` keeps it out of
  `activeKey` contention without removing it from the strip's keyboard path.
- **`aria-controls` is omitted rather than dangled.** A `Tabs.Tab` with no
  matching `Tabs.Panel` gets no pointer at all.

## Related

- `PageHeader`: use when placing a page-level `Tabs` strip in the header's `bottomBar` slot.
- `PopupSelect`: use when adding a second-level view choice inside a tab's toolbar.

Same group: `Breadcrumb` · `Link` · `Pagination` · `Sidebar`

## Parts

1. **Tab strip.** A `tablist` of buttons, aligned left, center, right or justified.
2. **Tab.** A button whose label names a view, on one line; the selected one is marked by an underline on the strip's baseline (`default`) or a filled pill (`pill`), whose strip has no baseline.
3. **Baseline.** The hairline under an underline strip that the selected bar sits on.
4. **Panel.** The content one tab controls, shown below the strip.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Subtle ink on a clear ground. |
| Hovered | The subtle neutral hovered fill. |
| Pressed | The subtle neutral pressed fill. |
| Focused | Shows the focus ring on the tab with no fill; see Border. |
| Selected | Selected ink with the underline bar, or the neutral fill with the default ink in `pill`. |
| Disabled | Disabled ink; the tab cannot be pressed or selected. |

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Tab height | `--control-md` (default), `--control-sm` (compact) |

| Ink | `--ds-text-subtle`, selected `--ds-text-selected`, disabled `--ds-text-disabled` |

| Gap | `--stack-md`, pill strip `--inline-lg` (12) |
| Panel offset | `--section-stack-sm` |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, `--focus-ring-width` |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use nouns that name the view: “Sessions”. | Use verbs or full sentences. |
| Write labels in sentence case, one to two words. | Use Title Case or labels that wrap. |
| Keep the same labels across visits. | Rename a tab to show a count or status. |
| Order tabs by how often people open them, most used first. | Hide the most used view in the last tab. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | node | — | `Tabs.Tab` elements, which fill the tablist, and the `Tabs.Panel` elements that follow it. |
| `alignment` | enum | `'left'` | Horizontal alignment of the tab strip |
| `appearance` | enum | `'default'` | Underline indicator (default), or a pill-shaped selected fill. |
| `spacing` | enum | `'default'` | `default` is a 32px tab; `compact` is 24px. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class on the tabs root, beside `plus-tabs`. |
| `id` | string | — | Id set on the tabs root. |
| `defaultActiveKey` | string or number | — | The `eventKey` of the tab selected at first, for uncontrolled use. |
| `activeKey` | string or number | — | The `eventKey` of the selected tab, for controlled use. Pair it with `onSelect`. |
| `onSelect` | func | — | Called with the newly selected `eventKey` whenever selection moves. |

## Variants

**`alignment`** — `left` · `center` · `right` · `justified`

**`appearance`** — `default` · `pill`

**`spacing`** — `default` · `compact`
